text.p: Singapore's Keppel Corp said on Tuesday it was consolidating its telecommunication business under its unit Steamers Maritime Holdings Ltd.

It said its subsidiaries Straits Steamship Land Ltd (SSL) and Far East Levingston Shipbuilding Ltd (FELS) have signed agreements to sell their respective 20 percent stakes in Keppel Telecoms Pte Ltd to Steamers.
The proposed transaction is valued at Singapore $8.1 million. Steamers will pay for the acquisition by issuing 7.3 million new shares, a company statement said.
Steamers will then own 60 percent of Keppel Telecoms while Keppel Corp will hold the remaining 40 percent, it said.

Keppel Corp, through Keppel Telecoms, holds a 35 percent interest in MobileOne (Asia) Pte Ltd, which in 1995 was awarded operating licences by the Telecommunications Authority of Singapore for cellular telephones and paging services. These services would start in April 1997.
MobileOne is a consortium of Keppel Corp, Singapore Press Holdings, Cable & Wireless and Hongkong Telecom .
